here’s a quick breakdown of the tasks and timelines:
Task 1: Already completed - I’ve created the Apollo URL search
Task 2: The scraping has been started and is currently in progress. Due to Apollo’s recent restrictions, scraping typically takes about a week to complete.
Task 3: Once the scraping is done, she’ll be able to launch your campaigns the same day. In the meantime, have her work on tightening up the scripts this week and setting up the SDR system so everything is ready to go
Task 4: After the campaigns are launched, you’ll want to optimize only once each variant reaches 250 sends. I’ll be happy to join as well and support you both in fine-tuning the results.
For the Instantly domains, you have to wait two weeks if they are normal domains meaning domains with his name and business name, but if they are pre-warmed domains, we can just buy it from Instantly directly without the wait. However the prewarmed domains do not have his name or brand name, they are random names - which in this case works because he's looking to buy, not sell,  so they can be looking on behalf of him. and he can later chime in anyway and intrdouce himself.

Here’s a polished, professional client email version of your message:  

---

**Subject:** Next Steps and Timeline Overview  

Hi [Client Name],  

I wanted to provide a quick update on where things stand and what to expect over the next couple of weeks.  

**Task 1 – Completed**  
The Apollo URL search has been created and finalized.  

**Task 2 – In Progress**  
Scraping is underway. Due to Apollo’s recent restrictions, this process typically takes about one week to complete.  

**Task 3 – Preparation Phase (This Week)**  
Once the scraping is finished, your campaigns can be launched the same day. In the meantime, [Name] will work on tightening up the scripts and setting up the SDR system so everything is ready for launch as soon as the data is complete.  

**Task 4 – Optimization Phase (Post-Launch)**  
After the campaigns go live, we’ll want to begin optimizing once each variant reaches approximately 250 sends. I’ll join you both during this stage to help fine-tune performance and ensure strong conversion results.  

**Instantly Domains**  
If you’re using **standard domains** (containing your name or business), they’ll need a two-week warm-up period before use. However, if you opt for **pre-warmed domains** purchased directly from Instantly, there’s no wait time. These domains use neutral names, which actually work well in this case since outreach is positioned as buying interest on your behalf. You can always follow up later with a personal introduction once initial contact is established.  

Please let me know which domain option you’d prefer so we can align timelines accordingly.  

Best regards,  
**Bethany Gifford**  
Founder | New Era Intel  
[Your Contact Info or Signature Block]  

---

Would you like me to make this version slightly warmer and more conversational (e.g., for a client you have a close working relationship with)?

Sure — please paste the text you’d like me to turn into the professional client email about next steps and timelines. Once I have that, I’ll format it with a clear subject line, polished tone, and professional structure.
